function.name: user_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a given user by their ID. It filters the mandates based on their status if provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user for whom mandates are being fetched.

status.description: The status of the mandates to fetch. If not specified, mandates of all statuses are returned.

message.content: Sure! To retrieve the mandates, I’ll need the user’s unique identifier (the `user_id`). Could you provide that? Once I have it, I can fetch all mandates that are either “pending” or “active”.
message.reasoning: The user says: "need all pending and active mandates". They want to fetch mandates for a user? But they didn't specify user id. We need to ask for user id. Also we can ask if they want both statuses or just one. The instruction: "If you do not have enough context to answer the question, ask clarifying questions." So we should ask for clarification: which user id? Or maybe they want all mandates across all users? That seems unlikely. We'll ask for user id.
